cases.name: macros: defaults < caller < embed node, macro-in-macro, both spellings, unresolved, empty default
viewer mode (screenPath null): refs resolve against the declaring document; dotted embed name
screenPath given: the same nesting resolves root-relative
depth 8: a chain of ten documents expands to depth 8
cycle, screenPath given: the top is on the path, so a self-embed and a->b->a stop at once
cycle, viewer mode: the top is not on the path, so each self-cycle expands the top once more
unloadable embeds keep their index; an empty file takes none
leading /, screenPath given: the runtime strips it; the ref is root-relative
leading /, viewer mode: the stripped ref is joined to the top document's directory
viewer mode: one file reached through two spellings expands twice before the cycle guard sees it
channels: loc://, formula://, y_channels, actions and rules props, rule-only, loc-only rules, formula rules
node set = what the renderer mounts: no descent into embedded-display, unknown-widget or unmapped children
a rule retargeting an embed's file: keys and PVs follow base props
hidden nodes: a base-hidden embed keeps its index and is not expanded; a hidden node and everything under it is not listed
